scripts.build: pnpm --filter @runtypelabs/persona build && cd slides && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:single: pnpm --filter @runtypelabs/persona build && cd slides && tsc -b && SINGLEFILE=1 vite build --outDir dist-single && mv dist-single/index.html dist-single/Bento_Slides.bento.html && node ../scripts/postbuild-compress.mjs dist-single/Bento_Slides.bento.html
scripts.build:web: cd slides && tsc -b && SINGLEFILE=1 vite build --outDir ../../../apps/web/dist/bento --emptyOutDir
